gaps: 2016: no official full pricing table found on hyundainews.com after 3 searches (release 1992 gives only the $17,250 starting MSRP and $825 freight). cars.com research and Edmunds pages for 2016 show used-market values rather than MSRP and caranddriver.com was blocked, so Autoblog's May 17, 2015 article (quoting Hyundai's release) was used as the secondary. 2016 SE automatic MSRP not captured.
2018: only the June 6, 2018 price sheet was found; launch (fall 2017) prices may differ slightly.
2021: Jan 8, 2021 sheet confirms a freight increase to $1,005 but its MSRP column did not extract; prices recorded are from the Oct 21, 2020 launch sheet.
2023: only the Jan 4, 2023 (2023C) sheet was found, not the launch sheet.
2024: freight differs between the gas sheet (Sep 2023, $1,115) and the HEV sheet (Jan 2024, $1,150); `destination` records the gas-sheet figure.
2025: the top hybrid trim's label ($29,450) was not legible in the fetched release; recorded as HEV Limited with a note.
hyundainews.com HTML release pages (e.g. /releases/2114, /releases/1992) render client-side and returned no text via WebFetch; PDF assets were used instead.
